VISUAL REFRESH ONLY — the contract

Every element on the four current screens must survive, on the same screen, with the same behavior. Recolor, retype, respace, reshape: yes. Remove, move, merge, or change how anything works: no.

Exercise screen must keep: every set as its own editable row (up to 5), complete toggle that also un-toggles, weight and reps − / +, copy-previous-set, Prev / Skip / Next, alternate-exercise toggle, cue + target line, last-workout chips, progress chart, suggestion banner, collapsed notes row with the "Last time:" preview, W warm-up marking.

Why: the last redesign looked great and broke all of this in the gym.

HARD LIMITS

iPhone 16 Pro home-screen app, no vertical scrolling. The exercise screen (worst case, above right) has ~10 px of slack — anything taller must be paid for on the same screen.

One fixed layout for all exercises: sizes never change with the number of sets. Shorter exercises leave room at the bottom on purpose.

Hit sizes stay: steppers 44×44, set toggle 36×44, prev/next 64×64, ? 36×36.

No pills for primary buttons, no fake status bar, no tabs, no timer.

Directions A and B below are two honest starting points — restyle either, or the current screen, in place.
